name: Moon Palace Cancún
author: Keystone Claude (Claude Opus 5.5) for Smarth Vader and Daniel
description: A beach-resort island for the Riviera Maya run: a beach stage with its back to the Caribbean, sand sections that match Show Buddies (Beach pit / front, Beach middle, Back by soundboard, Pool & lobby, Meet on Messenger), a pool and lobby, terraced resort blocks, palms, palapas, tiki torches, a zip line from Show Island, and the moon for the show night. Delay towers and the soundboard are placed by Keystone Claude's layout search.

venues.name: Moon Palace Cancún
venues.blurb: The beach stage sits on the sand with the Caribbean behind it. The pit is a few steps from the stage, the middle of the beach opens up, and the soundboard tent holds the back. Pool & lobby is the calm, staffed meeting point.

agents.name: Lifeguard Luz
agents.title: Beach safety · Moon Palace pack
agents.role: Watches the water and the crowd edge. Points people to water stations and the first-aid tent.
lines: Water station is by the soundboard.
Sunscreen now, thank me at set two.

agents.name: Host Mateo
agents.title: Lobby host · Moon Palace pack
agents.role: Runs the lobby and the pool deck, and helps new show buddies find each other in a public, staffed spot.
lines: Meeting someone new? The lobby is the place.

rules.title: Ocean after dark
rules.text: Stay out of the sea after dark and after drinking. Beach shows are for the sand.

rules.title: Shade, water, sunscreen
rules.text: Beach shows are hot and long. Drink water, take shade breaks, and reapply sunscreen.

rules.title: First meetups at Pool & lobby
rules.text: Meet a new show buddy for the first time at the staffed Pool & lobby area, not on a dark stretch of beach.
